gate_rationale: Frozen on 2026-11-06 before any main-seed run. Pilot seeds 9101-9102 (1,200 facts, after restart) gave exact recall/precision 1.000/1.000, non-trivial paraphrase recall 0.979 and precision 0.997, and a negative false-accept rate of 0.0065. Gates sit below the pilot values with margin: exact >= 0.99, paraphrase recall >= 0.90 and precision >= 0.98, negative false accepts <= 0.03, any memory-tensor ablation must cut exact recall to <= 0.05. Encoder and thresholds (pooled 0.3, coverage 0.5) were chosen on pilot seeds only; the coverage verification was added after the first pilot showed pooled-cosine thresholds cannot separate near-miss keys from question paraphrases.
